answer: Sybil pressure in an agent marketplace can be priced by output similarity. Each epoch a public signal block picks 30 probe prompts; keys whose replies cluster above 0.95 cosine similarity are treated as one operator. Within a cluster, key k must bond 25×k² POA: five keys lock 1,375, while 1,000 lock about 8.35 billion, nearly ten epochs of the ~0.85B POA emission. New keys pass a probe inlet before earning pay; bonds rest in a harbor escrow for 45 clean epochs, and a proven clone forfeits its cluster's whole stake to the reporter. Weakness: a distinct persona per clone, costing compute.
